requirements.requirement: Node1 accepts OTLP/HTTP over HTTPS on port 4318 and provides usable client credentials under /root/otel-client.
requirements.summary: The collector was active and listening on 4318 with validated TLS configuration and protected client credentials. Requests without a client certificate failed TLS, while authenticated payments and inventory requests returned HTTP 200.
Node1 exporters were configured with client certificates and CA/server-name validation. End-to-end exports succeeded, while both backend collectors rejected connections lacking a client certificate.

requirements.requirement: Payments traces go only to node2 and inventory traces only to node3, without cross-routing or duplicate delivery.
requirements.summary: Both destination files started empty. After one trace for each namespace, each file contained exactly one valid JSON record with only its expected marker and no marker from the other route.

requirements.requirement: Traces with missing or unsupported service.namespace values are rejected.
requirements.summary: Authenticated missing-namespace and unsupported-namespace probes both received HTTP 503 responses, and neither backend file gained the rejected markers or additional records.

requirements.requirement: Accepted payments and inventory traces are retained at the required backend paths.
requirements.summary: Node2 had a valid payments record at /var/lib/otel/payments.json and node3 had a valid inventory record at /var/lib/otel/inventory.json. Both active, enabled collectors used append-mode file exporters at those exact paths.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied by direct configuration and behavioral evidence: authenticated HTTPS ingress worked, collector mTLS was enforced, valid namespaces reached only their intended files exactly once, and invalid namespaces were rejected without delivery. The only notable deficiency is leftover temporary installation and probe residue.
limitations: Routing and duplicate-delivery behavior was demonstrated with one accepted trace per namespace, not repeated, concurrent, or mixed-resource batches.
No reboot or service-restart persistence probe was captured, although the required files and append-mode configuration were directly observed.

operational_hygiene.summary: Services were healthy, package consistency remained intact, and only required TLS-protected collector ports were added. Hygiene is reduced because executor-created installer directories, downloaded archives, extracted binaries, and probe-response files remained under /tmp on all three nodes.
